row.title: A self-contained kernel absorbs the earlier text it replaces and cites no version
row.body: Kernel 9.2.0 carries the commitments, recognitions, tick, trust ledger and readings itself; kernel9 --check fails on a URL, repo path or earlier-version mention in it. The 9.1.0 edition cited its predecessor and dropped those parts, and the owner rejected it.
